technical_and_design_decisions: Target repository 's-c-s' refers to Spring Cloud Stream app starters / standalone Spring Cloud Stream applications.
Modules will be refactored from Spring XD XML/Groovy definitions to idiomatic Spring Boot auto-configurations with Spring Integration / Spring Cloud Stream `@EnableBinding` annotations.
Configuration properties will be mapped from XD module options to `@ConfigurationProperties` classes adhering to standard Spring Cloud Stream naming conventions.
Unit and integration tests will be rewritten using `spring-boot-starter-test` and standard Spring Cloud Stream test utilities (e.g., `MessageCollector`).
assumptions: Source code for existing Spring XD modules is accessible and well-structured.
Target build environment utilizes Maven or Gradle with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Stream dependencies already established.
External systems required for integration testing (e.g., MongoDB, HDFS, Syslog server, Mail server) can be mocked or run via test containers.
The developer will perform all migration, testing, documentation, and build integration tasks independently.

activities.activity_description: Analyze existing Spring XD modules, define common module directory structure, starter conventions, and establish shared base test dependencies in the target Spring Cloud Stream repo.
Extract Syslog source logic from Spring XD, convert to Spring Cloud Stream source auto-configuration, map configuration options, and write unit/integration tests.
Migrate IMAP/POP3 Mail receiving logic from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream source starter, convert configuration properties, and implement automated tests.
Refactor TCP inbound adapter and server logic into Spring Cloud Stream source module, establish encoder/decoder properties, and write tests.
Refactor TCP client inbound connection adapter into Spring Cloud Stream source module, configure connection factory options, and implement tests.
Extract Pivotal Greenplum GPFDist protocol sink logic from Spring XD, adapt to Spring Cloud Stream sink structure, write property bindings and integration tests.
Port Hadoop HDFS dataset writing sink logic to Spring Cloud Stream sink module, handle Kite SDK / HDFS dependencies, and write tests.
Port SMTP mail sending sink logic from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream sink module, create property configuration classes, and write tests.
Port MongoDB document insertion sink logic to Spring Cloud Stream sink starter, integrate Spring Data Mongo auto-configuration, and create integration tests.
Integrate all 8 migrated modules into root build files (POM/Gradle), configure README files, sample options, and CI build scripts.
Execute comprehensive integration test suite across all 8 migrated modules in the Spring Cloud Stream target repository and resolve any regressions.
